weekly_theme.summary: 水星目前正在逆行（落在天蠍座，10/24–11/13），這段時間適合放慢腳步、重新確認訊息，避免倉促簽約或做重大決定。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，你充滿活力的精神今天閃耀著光芒！在處理日常活動時，你可能會充滿活力。你冒險的一面正在燃燒，需要很多時間來抑制你的精神。然而，目前內心的問題可能會帶來一些挑戰。看來愛情和浪漫可能不會如你所願地展開。請記住，耐心是關鍵。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, your vibrant spirit shines brightly today! You’re likely to be brimming with energy as you tackle your daily activities. Your adventurous side is on fire, and it takes a lot to dampen your spirits. However, matters of the heart may present some challenges at the moment. It seems that love and romance might not be unfolding as you wish. Remember, patience is key.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，你今天可能會發現自己與親愛的朋友或伴侶建立了更牢固的聯繫。浪漫的氛圍越來越強烈，你逐漸減少了預訂，讓自己完全擁抱這一刻。當您走出殼層，讓俏皮的一面閃耀出來時，您會發現喜悅和興奮。撇開任何沉重的話題，優先考慮享受和社交。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, you might find yourself forging a stronger bond with a dear friend or partner today. Romantic vibes are intensifying, and you're gradually shedding your reservations, allowing yourself to fully embrace the moment. You'll discover the joy and thrill that arise when you step out of your shell and let your playful side shine. Set aside any heavy topics and prioritize enjoyment and socializing.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，有堅定的信念和獨立感通常是一個積極的特質。然而，在某些時刻，這種意志堅強的天性可能會將您想與之聯繫的人推開。在你的浪漫生活中，你可能會發現自己正在努力應對頑固和敏感的混合。看來你可能傾向於邏輯，而你的伴侶正在更深入地了解他們的感受。
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, having firm beliefs and a sense of independence is usually a positive trait. However, there are moments when this strong-willed nature might push away those you wish to connect with. In your romantic life, you may find yourself grappling with a blend of stubbornness and sensitivity. It seems you might be leaning towards logic, while your partner is navigating their feelings more deeply.

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，今晚將為你帶來充滿感官和激情的時刻。期待有趣、興奮、浪漫和熱愛成為焦點，特別是因為你有能力把夜晚引向這個方向。堅定不移，不要讓其他人控制你的旅程。你很清楚自己的慾望，所以不要假裝不瞭解。愛就在眼前，準備好抓住它！
cancer.horoscope_en: Tonight promises to be filled with sensual and passionate moments for you, Cancer. Expect fun, excitement, romance, and love to take center stage, especially since you have the power to steer the evening in that direction. Stand firm and don’t allow anyone else to control your journey. You’re aware of your desires, so don’t pretend otherwise. Love is on the horizon—be ready to seize it!

leo.horoscope: 看來你的浪漫生活已經暫停了，獅子座。然而，這並不意味著你應該停止享受自己。今天充滿了歡笑和喜悅的機會，只要你不沉浸在愛情生活的緩慢節奏中。擁抱樂趣，同時以悠閒的步調做事。盡情享受每個體驗，並抵制急於發展下一步的衝動。
leo.horoscope_en: It might seem like your romantic life has hit a pause button, Leo. However, this doesn’t mean you should stop enjoying yourself. Today is filled with opportunities for laughter and joy, as long as you don’t dwell on the slower rhythm of your love life. Embrace the fun while taking things at a leisurely pace. Relish each experience and resist the urge to hurry to what’s next.

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，宇宙在愛情方面為你排列得很好。期待你的浪漫生活有正面的發展。請務必慷慨地向伴侶表達你的感情，因為他們的自尊心可能會得到提升。只要小心不要過度放縱他們，因為這可能會導致一種權利感，使你自己的慾望和需求蒙上陰影。
virgo.horoscope_en: The cosmos are aligning beautifully for you in matters of love, Virgo. Expect positive developments in your romantic life. Make sure to express your affection generously to your partner, as their self-esteem could use a boost. Just be cautious not to overindulge them, as this could lead to a sense of entitlement that overshadows your own desires and needs.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，你溫柔而充滿激情的天性今天走到了最前沿。就好像你的浪漫精髓閃耀著光芒，讓所有人都能看到。像表演者一樣擁抱這一刻，享受每一秒！宇宙能量正在對齊，以幫助你獲得更清晰的愛情觀，讓你能夠以大膽和天賦來處理它。不要猶豫，更公開地表達您的需求和願望。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, your tender and passionate nature is coming to the forefront today. It’s as if your romantic essence is shining brightly for all to see. Embrace this moment like a performer in the spotlight, relishing every second! The cosmic energies are aligning to help you gain a clearer perspective on love, allowing you to tackle it with both boldness and flair. Don’t hesitate to voice your needs and desires more openly.

scorpio.horoscope: 走進聚光燈下，擁抱你的情感深度，天蠍座。雖然愛情和浪漫可能會讓你感到暴露，但你沒有必要隱藏自己的這一部分。你可能會認為其他人已經解決了所有問題，但請記住，他們與你分享同樣的不安全感！讓你的敏感性輻射出來；展現你的脆弱性是非常吸引人的。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Step into the spotlight and embrace your emotional depth, Scorpio. While love and romance might make you feel exposed, there's no need to conceal this part of yourself. You might believe that others have it all figured out, but remember, they share the same insecurities as you do! Allow your sensitive nature to radiate; showing your vulnerability is incredibly appealing.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，你正處於一個絕佳的位置，可以引導你的生活朝著你想要的方向前進。抓住這一刻掌控一切！然而，請注意，一個重要的方面--你的愛情生活--可能不會如你所願地展開。你可能會遇到一種特別固執的心態，讓人覺得難以理解，這很可能是你自己的心態。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, you're in a prime position to steer your life in the direction you desire. Seize this moment to take charge! However, be aware that one significant aspect—your love life—might not be unfolding as you wish. You may encounter a particularly obstinate mindset that feels impenetrable, and it could very well be your own.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天就和你所愛的人一起擁抱快樂吧。拋開你的擔憂，放下任何有關享受自己的潛在缺點的想法。讓自己沉浸在當下的刺激中。你擁有與伴侶建立令人難以置信的深厚聯繫的力量。星星是為了愛而對齊的，所以帶著自信挺身而出。無需懷疑或不安全感，請自豪。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Embrace joy with your loved ones today, Capricorn. Set aside your concerns and let go of any thoughts about potential downsides to enjoying yourself. Immerse yourself in the thrill of the present moment. You possess the power to forge incredibly deep connections with your partner. The stars are aligned for love, so step forward with assurance. There's no need for doubt or insecurity—carry yourself with pride.

aquarius.horoscope: 水瓶座，你是一個隱藏的寶藏！對於那些真正看到你的人來說，你對愛和忠誠的能力閃耀著光芒。沒有必要隱瞞或掩飾你的才華。擁抱您的尊貴精華，展現您的獨特品質。你的寧靜和迷人的精神是顯而易見的，揭示了你擁有的神聖屬性。任何有幸今晚和你在一起的人都是真正的祝福，確保他們值得你非凡的存在。
aquarius.horoscope_en: Aquarius, you are a hidden treasure! Your capacity for love and loyalty shines brightly for those who truly see you. There's no need to hold back or conceal your brilliance. Embrace your regal essence and showcase your unique qualities. Your serene and enchanting spirit is evident, revealing the divine attributes you possess. Anyone fortunate enough to be with you this evening is truly blessed—ensure they are deserving of your extraordinary presence.

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，你可能會發現自己陷入了與最親近的人（無論是朋友還是伴侶）的強烈感情和不屈不撓的觀點的旋風中。表達你的真實情緒現在可能會感到有挑戰性。看起來好像你周圍的每個人都在仔細檢查你的一舉一動。請記住，不要讓你的驕傲妨礙你的享受。敞開心扉，不必為他人的回應而煩惱。
pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, you might find yourself caught in a whirlwind of intense feelings and unyielding perspectives with those closest to you, whether friends or partners. Expressing your true emotions could feel challenging right now. It may seem as though everyone around you is scrutinizing your every move. Remember, don’t allow your pride to hinder your enjoyment. Open up about your feelings without fretting over others' responses.
